comment: Source is not published. Read against docs/modules/Vektor/Manual.md at tag v2.6.13, a long and careful manual. Every parameter is configured with an empty name; they are identified from the rendered panel and the manual's specification list, which names exactly the five context buttons A, B, C, D and MIX, the five left-side buttons, the PAGE button, the DATA ENTRY encoder and the ENV. button. The five left-side buttons are tagged to one line and the five context buttons to another, because within each group the button does the same job and the line is written about the one that was clicked. The joystick and the WARN./ERR. lamp are not parameters and have no census position, so they get no line and no tag; the joystick is covered by a Note because the module cannot be used without it. The Model (theme) submenu is the plugin-wide one and gets no line; Restore saved settings appears under both MIX ENVelope and Program # and is left out as self-explanatory.
